body:
Ubuntu 24.04 / GCC 13 release build.

All packages include lavik, lavik-meta, lavik-ctl, LICENSE and notices.
- Standard: DPDK/SPDK included; x86-64-v2 or ARMv8-A+CRC32 required.
- Minimal: kernel TCP/io_uring only; compiler-default CPU target.

Both variants require Linux 6.1+ with io_uring enabled for lavik and
lavik-meta, including DPDK/SPDK deployments, and Ubuntu 24.04-compatible glibc.

Source: [3955b98d43b312324aa8d52775df52cfb111c0d0](https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/commit/3955b98d43b312324aa8d52775df52cfb111c0d0)

[Hardware and platform requirements](https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/blob/3955b98d43b312324aa8d52775df52cfb111c0d0/README.md#release-hardware-and-platform-requirements)


## What's Changed
* feat(cluster): recover populations with always-on failover by @liunyl in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/66
* docs: restore benchmark reports with English defaults by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/69
* feat(onboarding): add startup tools and benchmark comparisons by @liunyl in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/71
* docs(benchmarks): emphasize measured throughput advantages by @liunyl in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/73
* ci: publish standard and minimal nightly packages for x86_64 and ARM64 by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/75
* build: share Ubuntu dependency setup and fix nightly SPDK builds by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/76
* Add native AMD64/ARM64 CI and fix full-suite failures by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/62
* chore: finish Lavik naming cleanup and update Bycorf by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/78
* perf(cluster): avoid read admission allocation and borrow MOVED hosts by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/80
* perf(cluster): use cached authority snapshots for request admission by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/79
* docs: discourage blocking mutexes shared across workers by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/81
* ci: publish versioned packages from release tags by @thweetkomputer in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/82
* feat(replication): add bounded candidate recovery and partial reparent by @liunyl in https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/pull/70


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/commits/v0.1.0-beta.1
